title: Reduction of G-equivariant cosheaves to a QFD
body_html:
Reduction of $G$-equivariant cosheaves to a QFD

Setting: $X' \subseteq X$ is a QFD for the $G$-action with stabilizing subgroup $G'$. Let $\mathscr{C}$ be a category.

Let $\mathrm{SRep}_G(\mathscr{C})$ be the category whose objects are triples $(K, V, a)$ with $K \le G$, $V \in \mathscr{C}$, $a : K \to \Aut_\mathscr{C}(V)$; a morphism $(f, r)$ requires an injective $f : K \hookrightarrow L$ and $r \in \Hom_\mathscr{C}(V,W)$ intertwining $a, b$.

Definition. For a cosheaf $K$ of subgroups of $G$ on $X'$, let $\Cosh_{G',K}([\![X']\!], \mathscr{C})$ be the full subcategory of $\Cosh_{G'}(X', \mathrm{SRep}_G(\mathscr{C}))$ of those $V$ such that:

  • $(V_E, a^{V_E})$ is a $K_E$-representation in $\mathscr{C}$ for each $E \in [\![X']\!]$;
  • $r^V_{E,E'} : V_E \to V_{E'}$ is $a^{V_E}_g$-equivariant for $E' \preceq E$;
  • $a^V_{g,E} : V_E \to V_{gE}$ intertwines $a^{V_E}$ and $a^{V_{gE}}$: $a^V_{g,E} \circ a^{V_E}_k = a^{V_{gE}}_{gkg^{-1}} \circ a^V_{g,E}$;
  • $a^{V_E}_k = a^V_{k,E}$ for $k \in \Fix_G(E) \cap K_E$.

Proposition. Let $K$ be the cosheaf on $X'$ with $\Fix_G(E) = \Fix_{G'}(E) K_E$ for all $E$. Then $$\Cosh_G(X, \mathscr{C}) \;\simeq\; \underline{\mathrm{Fun}}([X']_{[X/G]}, \mathscr{C}) > \;\simeq\; \Cosh_{G', K}(X', \mathscr{C}).$$

The first equivalence is essentially the QFD equivalence $\iota : [X']_{[X/G]} \to [X/G]$ at the level of categories; the second unfolds the $K$-action data. The reverse construction uses the factorization $\mathrm{Hom}_{]X/G[}(E,E') = \{kn : k \in K_E,\ n \in G',\ nE \preceq E'\}$.

Why it matters

This proposition is the keystone for §4 (Heisenberg–Weil equivalence) and §8 (reduction to depth zero): equivariant data on the full generalized building $\BSigma$ can be checked on the apartment $A$. See Res and Sat functors between Coeff_G(B(Σ), Φ) and Coeff_M⁰(B(M)).
